title: Turn a form photo into a record, assembled
sub: Read the image into a fixed schema, retry once on a low-confidence field, and confirm with a person before saving.

steps.h: A photo of the intake form arrives
steps.d:
one image + "Extract name, date of birth, reason for
visit and insurance ID as JSON. Use \"unknown\" for
anything you cannot read."

steps.h: The model reads the image and returns JSON
Your code checks the reply — one field is unreadable
steps.d:
date_of_birth = "unknown" -> code crops the top-left
corner of the image and asks again, just for that field

steps.h: The model tries again on the cropped detail
steps.d:
{"date_of_birth": "unknown"}
(the handwriting genuinely isn't legible in the photo)

steps.h: Your code validates the shape — every field present
steps.d:
all four fields present and typed correctly
(one is the literal value "unknown", which still validates)

steps.h: Your code checks the gate and pauses the run
steps.d:
reason=low_confidence (date_of_birth could not be read)
the run returns a checkpoint here; nothing is saved until
a person decides
(the direct pass-through to Record saved, below, was not
taken this run)

steps.h: A person reviews the paused record against the photo
steps.d:
sees: the photo, the extracted record, reason: low_confidence
reads the date of birth off the physical form and edits it in
decides: edit, then approve

steps.h: Your code resumes and saves the corrected record
